name: token-monitor
description: Deprecated native monitor. Replaced by TokenMonitor Embedded, including remote chats through Codex.

interface.longDescription: This native monitor is deprecated. Install TokenMonitor Embedded instead: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/Plugin_df57c7c0b9d08191936d851916050a02 . The embedded plugin works in local and Codex remote chats without a separate app or SSH monitoring setup. This legacy plugin remains only for removing existing companion installations. Uninstalling the plugin alone does not remove the native app, launch helper, or personal hooks. Saved monitor data is retained unless explicitly purged.
